key_insight: LLM-derived features from parent free text captured additional information about reported adolescent depression impact beyond structured symptoms, while adolescent self-reports showed no such evidence.
clinical_relevance: Parent narratives may complement structured assessments by capturing functioning-related concerns such as social exclusion, autonomy, coping, and responsibilities.
method: Analyzed adolescent and parent responses to the DAWBA depression section.
Used LLMs to extract information across a taxonomy of 80 outcomes from free text.
Applied sequential residual stacking to estimate incremental information from symptom totals, individual items, and text features.
evidence_signal: The preregistered study included 153 adolescent self-reports and 106 parent reports, with additional text-based information found only in parent reports.
watch_item: The moderate sample size makes these findings preliminary and does not establish clinical utility.
paper_title: Capturing additional variance in impact of adolescent depression from free text: proof of concept and preliminary results
